∀ (p : outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.Params),
  outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec.valid p →
    ∀ (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n → ℝ)
      (O : OracleTemplate.Oracle (OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n) (OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n)),
      outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec.admissible p f O →
        let A := outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.algorithm p.toPublic;
        outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec.successful p f
          (fun seed =>
            OracleTemplate.execute O A
              (fun x =>
                ⌈8 * p.J * p.Δ / p.ε ^ 2 + 2 * p.s * (↑(min p.m p.n) * √↑(min p.m p.n)) * p.Δ / (3 * p.J * p.ε)⌉₊ + 1)
              seed.1 seed.2)
          ⟨(↑(A.law 1)).prod ↑(O.law 1), ⋯⟩

∀ (p : outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.Params),
  outputs.Setups.MuonThirdOrderBounded.spec.valid p →
    ∀ (f : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n → ℝ),
      LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder.ThirdDerivativeBounded p.s f →
        BddBelow (Set.range f) →
          f p.W0 - ⨅ W, f W ≤ p.Δ →
            (∀ (W : OracleTemplate.Muon.Mat p.m p.n), LongTails.Setups.MuonThirdOrder.hessianQuadratic f W ≤ p.J) →
              let q := outputs.Algorithms.MuonBest.sourceInput p.toPublic;
              1 / ↑q.T *
                  ∑ j,
                    OracleTemplate.Muon.nuclearNorm
                      (gradient f (OracleTemplate.SimplifiedMuon.trajectory q (gradient f) ↑j)) ≤
                p.ε
